Kumaraswamy made the allegation while reacting to Shivakumar’s reported warning to his Cabinet colleagues about possible sting operations targeting ministers. He claimed that Shivakumar was now using the threat to keep his ministers under control. “Congress leaders themselves have told me that Shivakumar became Chief Minister after carrying out a sting operation and submitting it to the high command,” Kumaraswamy told reporters at the Janata Dal (Secular) office in Bengaluru. He alleged that Siddaramaiah had been called to Delhi on the pretext of discussions on Cabinet expansion but was instead confronted with the alleged sting material and pressured to resign. Kumaraswamy claimed the Congress high command, Shivakumar, and a media organisation were involved. items.title: Veteran actor Nana Patekar dies at 75 after cardiac arrest in Goa
items.summary: Veteran actor Nana Patekar died at the age of 75 after suffering a cardiac arrest at his residence in Dona Paula, Goa on October 8. According to media reports, Nana was found unconscious at his home after suffering severe chest pain and was taken to Manipal Hospital. Doctors attempted to revive him for around 45 minutes, but he could not be revived and was declared dead at 5.20 am. A medico-legal case has been registered and a post-mortem examination will be conducted. His son, Malhar Patekar, was in Pune when he received the news and left for Goa, according to reports. Nana, whose real name was Vishwanath Patekar, was one of the most distinctive actors in Hindi and Marathi cinema. Known for his intense screen presence and powerful dialogue delivery, he often played complex characters that fell outside conventional hero and villain roles. Born on January 1, 1951, in Maharashtra, Nana began his film career with the 1978 film Gaman . He went on to establish himself with performances in films including Ankush , Pratighaat , Salaam Bombay! , Parinda , Prahaar: The Final Attack , Angaar , Tirangaa , Krantiveer and Agni Sakshi .
